items.detail: The BWF results pages are a JavaScript shell and the match centre did not expose an unauthenticated endpoint to the runner. No official draw could be read.
The WTT event pages returned a 6.4 KB shell and no official draw could be read.
The AFLW fixture page is a JavaScript shell; the official AFL API returned HTTP 403/404. No fixture could be verified.
PGA Tour and DP World Tour pages are leaderboards, not head-to-head fixtures; no match market exists and no official field-strength table could be read from the runner.
Formula 1 and MotoGP publish race entry lists and results rather than match fixtures; no official rating table was readable, so no outright line is originated.
GBGB publishes results and open-race schedules, not a machine-readable fixture feed; no upcoming race could be verified.

91 High-confidence selections price at shorter than -250 American. They are published with the band flag rather than being hidden or relabelled: a >=70% probability implies fair odds of -233 or shorter, so only probabilities between 0.700 and 0.714 can satisfy both the confidence rule and the -250..+10,000 band at once.

items.category: NBA sample is two games or fewer
items.detail: 40 NBA fixtures are priced from the committed 22 Oct 17:08Z NBA.com capture. With one or two games played per team the sample gate fails, so no NBA row can be High; the rows are published as Medium or Low and the fixture, not the line, is the verified value.

items.category: ICC ratings are the May 2026 annual update
items.detail: The ICC rankings pages render client-side, so the strength inputs are the last published annual-update releases (Men's ODI 11 May 2026; Men's and Women's T20I 5 May 2026). The release date is printed on every row.
The IRL World Rankings page rendered only the men's table in the capture. Women's World Cup fixtures are published with no line and are listed here for review.

items.category: Total lines use a model assumption
items.detail: No official scoring mean was captured for these competitions, so the match-total line is a stated model assumption (268.5 runs for ODIs, 165.5 for T20Is, 44.5 points for RLWC). The handicap and match-winner markets are driven by the official rating table.
Four WTA rows carry the tour's 23:59 local placeholder because the order of play had not been published at capture time; the date is confirmed, the start time is not.

items.category: ATP start times are 'not before' times
items.detail: ATP fixtures and start times come from the official order-of-play PDF; the PDF states that any match may be moved, so times are the published session times, not guaranteed.

items.category: Gaelic football treated as out of scope
items.detail: The brief excludes 'football' and 'hurling'. OLBG separates Gaelic football from association football. Board AF publishes no Gaelic football rows; earlier boards disagree (some include it), so the scope call is flagged rather than silently resolved.

Two targets in the second, third and fourth capture passes shared an id (one web host, one admin host). The later request overwrote the earlier file, so the 200 body from matches.snooker.web.gc.wstservices.co.uk was not retained; the manifest now records it with file=null and the collision is disclosed here. Neither service is the source of a published row, so no published value depends on the lost bytes.

items.category: Darts strength model uses official seeds only
items.detail: The PDC order-of-merit page rendered no table to the runner. Darts probabilities are therefore a function of the official European Tour seedings, not of prize-money or form; the basis is printed on every row.
